name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 9 visits over 36 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 42 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 36 hours starting 2026-05-12, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
